name: OSReward benchmark resource icon — the judge
generationType: New generated hub resource icon in the OSReward mascot set (project logo: osreward-star-hd.png). Not an official release asset.
design: Candidate A of the OSReward mascot set: robot judge with a gold verdict stamp and check / cross cards.
prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create THREE separate images, and save them as _candidates/osreward-A.png, _candidates/osreward-B.png and _candidates/osreward-C.png in this repository. Create nothing else.

Context: these are candidate NEW mascots for the OSReward project in the OS-Copilot research hub. OSReward is about judging whether a computer-use agent really completed its task (a "reward model" / "judge"), and its open models are called OS-Shepherd. The attached images are other projects' mascots in the same hub: match their visual family (polished 3D cartoon illustration, glossy white robot shells, navy faces, glowing cyan eyes, crisp contours, soft shading), but each new design must be clearly DIFFERENT from the attached OSReward mascot (the seated robot holding a radar tablet with target, chart and checklist icons) — do not reuse that pose, tablet or icon arrangement.

Brand palette for all three: white and deep navy robot, with warm GOLD (#e2c377 / #cfa54b) as the signature accent, small touches of cyan; no green-dominant scheme.

A — "The judge": a small friendly robot judge holding a golden verdict stamp, beside two small floating cards, one with a check mark and one with a cross; a simple screen frame behind it hints at a computer screen being judged.
B — "The shepherd": a small robot holding a slim golden shepherd's crook, gently guiding three tiny floating app windows / screens like a flock; calm, protective feeling.
C — "The reward star": a small robot holding up a glowing golden star with both hands, with a few thin golden orbit lines and small sparkles around it.

For all three: one compact complete character centred on a square 1:1 canvas with comfortable margins, readable at 46 px and at 256 px; strong simple silhouette; genuinely transparent background (no backdrop, plate, frame or glow haze filling the canvas); no text, letters or numbers; no watermark.

After saving, report each path and its pixel size.

checked: Same visual family as the OSReward project mascot
Distinct silhouette from the other three OSReward icons at 60 px
Readable on dark and light hub themes
